whatnot.attach_first: Attach the Whatnot dashboard/live URL first.
whatnot.bind_help: Paste the seller live URL after you schedule. Uses the Whatnot login in this Chrome profile.
whatnot.control.heading: Whatnot control
whatnot.control.title: Whatnot Control Panel
whatnot.ext_not_connected: extension not connected — reload this tab
whatnot.from_whatnot: Pinned item, start, increment, qty, and current bid come from Whatnot. Reload the Chrome extension after updating it.
whatnot.gone_404: That Whatnot live URL is gone (404).
whatnot.hub.camera_help: Open this on the live phone. Pick a camera — that picture goes to the overlay.
whatnot.hub.control_help: Load SKU and overlay graphics. Pinned item and bids come from the Chrome extension on your Whatnot tab.
whatnot.hub.intro: OBS only imports the overlay URL. The live phone opens the camera link and sends picture + sound into that overlay.
whatnot.hub.optional_help: Open the camera URL on the live phone and pick a lens. OBS still uses the same overlay URL.
whatnot.hub.overlay_help: Add this URL once at 1080×1920. Do not add a camera in OBS.
whatnot.hub.step_ext_after: , unzip, Chrome → Extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked → select the unzipped folder that contains manifest.json (do not pick the parent folder).
whatnot.hub.step_obs: OBS — add this overlay URL once as a Browser Source (1080×1920, not transparent). Check Control audio via OBS. Uncheck Shutdown source when not visible. Do not add a camera or mic in OBS.
whatnot.hub.step_phone: Live phone — open this link, allow camera + mic, and pick the lens. That feed is what the overlay (and OBS) shows.
whatnot.hub.step_sku: On the control panel, type the SKU so overlay color + 3× MSRP come from inventory. Condition is always NEW.
whatnot.hub.step_tab: Keep your Whatnot seller live tab open. Pin the current item — the extension reads that listing and POSTs JSON to /whatnot_live/ingest.
whatnot.hub.title: Whatnot Live
whatnot.manual_bid: Manual overlay bid (does not bid on Whatnot)
whatnot.no_cookie: no Whatnot cookie in this Chrome profile
whatnot.paste_first: Paste the Whatnot live link first.
whatnot.preview_note: This preview is the same overlay OBS uses, including the phone camera.
